answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 160603 Country: india Title: My father died in 2007 how to share property value in 12000000/- 3 sons 4 daughters and father 2nd wife? Question: My father died in 2007 how to share property value in 12000000/- 3 sons 4 daughters and father 2nd wife? Answer ID: 160603 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 916/874/M=8/1439) According to Shariah, the property left by your deceased father will be divided into 80 shares. Out of the total, the widow of the deceased shall get 10 shares, 14-14 shares shall go to each son, and 7-7 shares to each daughter. The detail of Shariah division is as follows: Wife: 1 x 10 = 10 Sons: 3 x 14 = 42 Daughters: 4 x 07 = 28 Total 80 shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
